trade.text: He criticized Trump’s tariffs, saying they raised prices for consumers.
trade.quote: Trump’s tariffs have sent prices soaring on everything from groceries to home goods.

debt.text: He said his priority during debt negotiations was protecting Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid beneficiaries.
debt.quote: my bottom line has been to protect Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid.

immigration.text: Backed a citizenship pathway for undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: House Democrats support comprehensive immigration reform that includes smart border security

guns.text: He cosponsored legislation to ban assault weapons, bump stocks, and certain high-capacity magazines.
guns.quote: ban assault weapons, bump stocks and equivalent devices

abortion.text: He cosponsored legislation to limit restrictions on abortion services and protect patients’ and providers’ rights.
abortion.quote: limit restrictions on provision of abortion services to protect women’s

health.text: He opposed Medicaid cuts and urged policies to keep people covered through public health programs.
health.quote: Policies in Trump’s “One Big Beautiful Bill” cut nearly $1 trillion from Medicaid

debt.text: He says he would support fiscally conservative bills to cut spending and bring down the national debt.
debt.quote: Vote for bills in Congress that are fiscally conservative that cut spending, reduce inflation, and bring down the national debt

safety.text: He says he would champion tough-on-crime bills to protect law-abiding citizens and keep violent criminals off the street.
safety.quote: Champion bills that are tough on crime that protect law abiding citizens and keep violent criminals off the street

voting.text: He supports elections that require voter identification.
voting.quote: Fight for Free and Fair Elections that require Voter I.D.
